title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Recovering Trips Lost to Plant the Technician Could Not Reach
content:
## Dispatch bulletin: lost trips on settlement

The office recovers, in a settlement of a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record, the trips it lost to plant it could not reach. Two readings decide the recovery: the visits of the agreement closed as no-access, and whether a charge for a no-access trip already stands on the agreement.

| Reading of the agreement's history | Recovered |
|---|---|
| 2 or more visits closed as no-access and no charge for a no-access trip standing on the agreement | the tier's no-access trip fee for each of those visits |
| exactly 1 visit closed as no-access and no charge for a no-access trip standing on the agreement | the tier's no-access trip fee once |
| a charge for a no-access trip already stands on the agreement, or no visit was closed as no-access | nothing is recovered for trips lost to locked plant |

### Notes

- The fee recovered is the no-access trip fee published for the agreement's tier on the dispatch bulletin of booking fees.
- Where even one charge for a no-access trip already stands on the agreement, nothing is recovered under this bulletin, whatever the number of visits closed as no-access.

### Worked case (hypothetical)

An agreement at a tier whose no-access trip fee is 145.00 USD, with 3 visits closed as no-access and no charge for a no-access trip standing: 145.00 USD multiplied by 3, that is 435.00 USD, is recovered. With exactly 1 such visit and no such charge standing: 145.00 USD. With 3 such visits but a charge for a no-access trip already standing: nothing.
